name: Hangtown Kid Apple Orchard
tagline: Hangtown Kid Apple Orchard at https://www.hangtownkid.com
description: In 598 Mace Road, CA, Hangtown Kid Apple Orchard raises Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
